```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
```

```{r setup}
library(linregPackage)
```

## Fitting a Model

```{r fit}
data("iris")
mod <- linreg(Petal.Length ~ Species, data = iris)
```

## Model Output and Methods

```{r print}
print(mod)
```

```{r coef}
coef(mod)
```

```{r pred_resid}
head(pred(mod))
head(resid(mod))
```

```{r summary}
summary(mod)
```

```{r plot, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
plot(mod)
```
